baseline_models.mechanism: Intense visual contrast is held rather than erased: restriction supplies a boundary, while tenting turns that boundary into a place of settled presence.

activation_trace.role: The intense white-and-black eye contrast supplies a polarity that the enclosure preserves rather than flattens.
Literal confinement and restriction provide the model's bounded spatial operation.
Pitching and staying make the tents settled dwellings rather than incidental fabric.

changed_reading.before: A static picture of pale beauties hidden in tents.
changed_reading.after: Figures whose marked internal contrast is preserved within a stable, inhabited boundary.

baseline_models.mechanism: The noun can activate a purified helper, the participle can mark a specially restricted near relation, and the dwelling can carry fixed disposition; together they yield trusted resident counterparts.

activation_trace.role: The purified-helper range supplies companion agency and support.
Near relation and restriction to a special circle make the bond selective and intimate.
Fixed disposition makes residence also a claim about settled character.

changed_reading.before: Decorative occupants assigned to a private location.
changed_reading.after: Stable companions or helpers admitted to a relation of particular nearness.

baseline_models.mechanism: Return or change reaches an endpoint judged sufficient and then stays there; the enclosure is the completion of movement, not merely its prohibition.

activation_trace.role: Return, wavering, and change supply a temporal reversal rather than appearance alone.
Endpoint and sufficiency stop the reversal at an attained limit.
Tenting and staying convert the attained limit into an abode.

changed_reading.before: Beings immobilized by an external enclosure.
changed_reading.after: Returned or transformed presences that have reached a sufficient stopping-place.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: حُورٌ within the construction مَّقْصُورَاتٌ فِي الْخِيَامِ
baseline_models.mechanism: Speech returned back and forth occurs inside a protected limit; the tent becomes an intimate chamber of exchange rather than a silent display case.

activation_trace.role: Mutual speech, answer, and returned reply supply reciprocal voice.
Restriction gives the exchange a protected and private range.
Staying in a pitched dwelling gives reciprocal speech a durable scene.

changed_reading.after: A private sphere of responsive voices and returned address.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah's scale-and-justice sequence recodes limitation from raw deprivation into calibrated non-excess that can preserve differentiated relation.

activation_trace.role: Held eye-color difference supplies what a just boundary must preserve.
Confinement supplies the focus ayah's limit-setting operation.
The just-scale range makes limitation an instrument of equity rather than arbitrary closure.

structural_cues: 55:7-9 installs the balance, forbids excess in it, and commands just weighing before the focus portrait.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated just measure and focus confinement; I infer an ethical-spatial analogy in which a limit can sustain balance; the live alternative is ordinary imposed seclusion with no transfer from the scale sequence.

changed_reading.before: Confinement chiefly means deprivation of range.
changed_reading.after: The boundary may be a calibrated limit that protects proportion and non-excess.

context_deltas.mechanism: Plant sheath, grain husk, restricted residue, and tented staying form a material chain in which an outer layer guards concentrated value until it is ready.

activation_trace.role: The grain-remnant and husk range gives restriction a protective integument.
Tenting supplies the larger shelter that repeats the small-scale covering.
The plant vessel and fruit sheath establish enclosure as organic protection.
Grain husk and crumbling leaf add a removable outer layer around nourishment.

structural_cues: 55:11-12 places fruit in palm sheaths beside grain and husk, establishing nested coverings early in the surah.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies botanical coverings and the focus's husk-adjacent q-s-r branch; I infer a container-value relation from plant to pavilion; the live alternative is that the agricultural images never transfer to persons.

changed_reading.before: The tents hide their occupants from access.
changed_reading.after: The tents can act like sheaths that preserve concentrated life or ripeness rather than negate it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus line is bracketed by a recurring interrogative about blessings and denial, activating h-w-r's returned-speech branch so that the portrait itself functions as one turn in a sustained address.

activation_trace.role: Dialogue and returned reply let the focus noun carry responsive motion.
The blessings range identifies the recurring subject to which the portrait responds.
Truth's contrary makes the next refrain a demanded answer rather than neutral punctuation.

structural_cues: 55:71 and 55:73 place the same dual-address refrain immediately before and after 55:72.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact refrain bracketing and a focus branch of reciprocal speech; I infer that the nominal image participates in call-and-response; the live alternative is that the refrain frames but does not animate the image.

changed_reading.before: The ayah is an isolated descriptive tableau.
changed_reading.after: The ayah is also a responsive turn inside the surah's repeated challenge and answer-space.

context_deltas.mechanism: The meeting seas remain differentiated by a non-transgressed middle, then brilliance comes out of concealment; this sequence makes enclosure a productive interface rather than a sterile wall.

activation_trace.role: Restriction anchors the boundary operation in the focus participle.
Settled tenting turns the boundary into an inhabitable interface.
The middle interval between two things supplies a relational boundary rather than simple isolation.
Exceeding a limit through aggression defines what the sea-boundary prevents.
Bringing something out of concealment supplies emergence from the bounded relation.
Gleaming brilliance supplies the visible value produced after hidden emergence.

structural_cues: 55:19 lets two seas meet, 55:20 prevents boundary-violation, and 55:22 announces precious emergence from them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies meeting, a non-transgressed interval, and subsequent emergence; I supply the causal arrow that maintained difference enables value to appear; the live alternative is mere juxtaposition without causal force.

changed_reading.before: Being restricted in tents means being cut off from relation and production.
changed_reading.after: The pavilion-boundary can preserve difference while enabling precious relation and emergence.

context_deltas.mechanism: Universal disappearance followed by enduring remainder activates h-w-r as change or return; q-s-r then marks the attained end and the tent marks abiding after reversal.

activation_trace.role: Return and change let the inhabitants bear a before-and-after state.
Endpoint and sufficiency make enclosure the completed term of transformation.
Staying gives the transformed state durable residence.
Cessation and departure after prior continuance supply the lost state.
Duration and remaining supply the contrasting state that survives the reversal.

structural_cues: 55:26 universalizes perishing and 55:27 immediately opposes it with remaining before the later garden scenes.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a perish/remain reversal and a focus branch of return or state-change; I infer a temporal arc into settled transformed life; the live alternative is that hūr here activates only its eye-quality sense.

changed_reading.before: The occupants simply exist as timeless furnishings of the garden.
changed_reading.after: They may register changed or returned life brought through loss into an abiding endpoint.

context_deltas.mechanism: A tree-hidden garden contains reclining surfaces whose inner linings are named while fruit is near; the focus tent becomes the innermost hospitable chamber in a sequence where deeper interiority increases access.

activation_trace.role: The enclosed-building range gives the participle an architectural interior.
Tenting and staying place an inhabited chamber inside the larger garden enclosure.
A garden hidden by trees supplies the outermost living enclosure.
The garment-lining range makes the named inner surface itself a luxury and not an absence.
Nearness and approachability counter the assumption that interior placement means remoteness.

structural_cues: 55:46-54 moves from two gardens to branches, springs, fruit-pairs, reclining, inner linings, and fruit brought near.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies nested interiors together with increasing nearness; I infer that the tent continues this hospitality gradient; the live alternative is that each luxury is an independent catalogue item.

changed_reading.before: The tents are prison-like partitions remote from the garden's abundance.
changed_reading.after: They are protected inner guest chambers within a layered but accessible garden.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier active q-s-r construction restrains the gaze; its later passive cognate locates figures in tents. The morphological echo lets self-directed attention resonate inside protected placement without forcing the two constructions to be identical.

activation_trace.role: Confinement and holding back anchor the passive focus description.
Settled tenting supplies the location in which the passive state is maintained.
The same holding-back range appears earlier in an active feminine plural construction.
Blinking and sight identify the gaze as the actively bounded faculty.

structural_cues: 55:56 uses an active q-s-r participle with the gaze as object, whereas 55:72 uses a passive q-s-r participle with tents as location.
55:74 repeats the untouched-before formula from 55:56; its missing branch inventory is used only as a structural mirror.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the shared root, active/passive contrast, and repeated surrounding formula; I infer that agency from bounded attention can echo into bounded residence; live alternatives are imposed seclusion or two distinct groups with no semantic transfer.

changed_reading.before: The passive participle presents subjects acted upon and removed from view.
changed_reading.after: Protected placement coexists with an echo of self-kept attention, fidelity, or chosen relational focus.

context_deltas.mechanism: Pairing, action answered by commensurate action, and the immediate predicate of goodness and beauty activate h-w-r's helper and dialogue ranges; the inhabitants become responsive counterparts rather than visual rewards without agency.

activation_trace.role: The helper range supplies active support within companionship.
Returned speech supplies reciprocity rather than one-way possession.
Special nearness gives the responsive counterpart a particular relational bond.
A counterpart joined to its counterpart establishes pairing as relation.
Action met by its recompense supplies an answering relation between deed and return.
Doing what is good makes the repeated term active and ethical, not merely attractive.
Excellence, rectitude, and selection immediately before the focus supply moral quality.

structural_cues: 55:52 pairs every fruit, 55:60 balances goodness with goodness, and 55:70 places good and beautiful figures immediately before 55:72.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies pairing, reciprocal recompense, and moral predicates near the focus; I infer social agency and response in the h-w-r branches; the live alternative is a catalogue of rewards whose items remain object-like.

changed_reading.before: Beautiful secluded figures are rewards viewed from outside.
changed_reading.after: Good, selected counterparts answer relation with relation as helpers, partners, and voices.

context_deltas.mechanism: The second garden's saturated darkness activates both h-w-r's white/black contrast and q-s-r's evening range; beauty becomes relational contrast intensified by a dark field, not monochrome whiteness.

activation_trace.role: Intense white-and-black contrast makes darkness constitutive of the visual quality.
Evening and mingling darkness make the participle carry a threshold-light side image.
Deep blackness supplies the saturated field against which contrast intensifies.

structural_cues: 55:64 introduces the second garden pair as intensely dark-green before 55:72 names its inhabitants.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a dark garden field and two focus branches involving contrast and evening; I infer that context makes their polarity visually functional; the live alternative is that darkness describes foliage only.

changed_reading.before: Hūr signals simple whiteness or purity set apart from darkness.
changed_reading.after: Their quality is high contrast: brightness and darkness coexist and sharpen one another within the enclosure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing image of stable, growing good joins tented staying and settled disposition; permanence is recoded as rooted increase rather than frozen immobility.

activation_trace.role: Tenting and staying supply durable emplacement.
Settled disposition moves stability from location into character.
Limit and sufficiency define a completed place from which growth need not depart.
Stable, increasing good supplies dynamic flourishing without displacement.

structural_cues: 55:78 closes the surah with blessing after the focus scene and its repeated refrain.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies staying, settled nature, sufficiency, and finally stable growing good; I infer that the last cue distinguishes permanence from stasis; the live alternative is a generic closing doxology with no local effect.

changed_reading.before: Settled in tents means static and unchanging.
changed_reading.after: Their settled state can be rooted, sufficient, and continuously flourishing.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the water side of q-s-r is remote from the passive participle; it remains anchored in the exact focus root and in the surrounding flowing and gushing springs; downstream prose should present it only as a hydraulic analogy for charged containment, never as a lexical translation.

activation_trace.role: The qasir-water range opens a water-bearing material side to the focus root.
Settled tenting supplies the holding structure for the material analogy.
A source of running water establishes continuous flow in the first garden pair.
Abundantly gushing water adds pressure and release in the second garden pair.

changed_reading.after: Containment can hold charged abundance whose stillness implies sustained flow or release.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because leather, cloth-working, linings, curtains, and carpets are material branches rather than person-glosses; it remains valid as a cross-root analogy anchored in all three focus words and nearby furnishings; downstream prose should describe a tactile membrane-system, not identify the inhabitants with textiles.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: حُورٌ مَّقْصُورَاتٌ فِي الْخِيَامِ as an occupant-boundary-dwelling complex

activation_trace.role: Soft or red-worked leather supplies a skin-like tactile surface.
Fulling or shortening cloth supplies worked textile as a boundary-making process.
Tent fabric turns the textile range into inhabitable architecture.
A garment's lining supplies an explicit inner textile layer.
A hanging edge or fluttering cover extends the membrane beyond the tent wall.
Fine patterned carpets complete the layered tactile environment after the focus.

changed_reading.before: Tents are external boxes surrounding otherwise unrelated occupants.
changed_reading.after: Occupant, boundary, lining, hanging cover, and carpet form a layered tactile ecology of inside and outside.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because an axle branch and a non-dominant mapped branch of following sound are formally distant from hūr and ālāʾ; it remains anchored in exact packet branches plus the visibly repeated refrain around the focus; downstream prose should qualify it as a compositional analogy, not word sense.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: حُورٌ at the center of a refrain-bracketed ayah

activation_trace.role: Turning on an axis supplies rotational form to the focus noun's position in the repeated sequence.
Endpoint and limit make this focus line one bounded station in the rotation.
One sound following another supplies the acoustic recurrence immediately before the focus.
The same following-sound branch after the focus closes the local rotational turn.

changed_reading.before: The ayah is a stationary image between repeated lines.
changed_reading.after: It can be heard as a bounded station around which the refrain turns and returns.

strongest_changes: The active gaze-restraint of 55:56 revises the passive tent-containment of 55:72 toward coexisting agency and protection.
The non-transgressing sea boundary followed by jewel emergence makes limitation productive rather than sterile.
Pairing, reciprocal goodness, and immediately prior moral predicates activate hūr as responsive counterparts, helpers, and voices.
Nested garden, lining, nearness, darkness, and stable blessing turn the tents into accessible interiors where contrast and growth are preserved.
summary.what_was_special: All three focus roots bifurcate productively: h-w-r holds eye contrast, helperhood, return, dialogue, and rotation; q-s-r holds confinement, architecture, limit, husk, evening, textile, and water; kh-y-m holds both dwelling and disposition. Context sharpens several of these without forcing them into one final reading.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the active figures of 55:56 and the passive figures of 55:72 are the same group, analogous groups, or deliberately contrasting groups remains open.
The return, dialogue, and axial h-w-r activations are root-grounded but form-distant and should coexist with, not replace, the strong eye-contrast reading.
The botanical, hydraulic, and textile mechanisms may be deliberate material analogies or only latent branch resonance; they require cautious rendering.
